scope: targeted source and clean installed native-wheel acceptance; not a release or a second complete trajectory
build: clean git archive; AGENTFEM_BUILD_NATIVE=1; build --wheel --no-isolation; isolated target install without replacing the active environment
complete_run_reuse_boundary: The three native binaries are identical. Closing Python history-publication and prepared-operator failure changes have separate regressions; a complete trajectory was not rerun at the closing commit.

installed.pytest_config: -c /dev/null -p no:cacheprovider; PYTHONPATH points only to the clean installed target, not src

skip_reason: collective history mismatch test requires two MPI ranks

separate_mpi.scope: collective history mismatch and prepared linear/boundary reuse
separate_mpi.launcher: agentfem mpi-run, 180-second timeout, FI_PROVIDER=tcp, numerical thread limits of one

remote_ci.scope_note: The targeted FEniCSx job was skipped because the full fenicsx job ran. Remote job success is not a claim of external-code physical parity.

post_closing_source_followup.scope: Prepared MPC failure evidence/explicit nonconvergence policy and separate elastic-limit fixture controls; not another installed-wheel or full-trajectory run
post_closing_source_followup.previous_installed_candidate: Both failure-retry regressions fail against the 0913ab9a installation because the previous successful LinearSolveInfo remains after a new exception.

mpi.scope: MPC failure/retry, explicit diagnostic nonconvergence, load refresh and terminal ownership
mpi.launcher: agentfem mpi-run with 180-second timeout, FI_PROVIDER=tcp and numerical thread limits of one

counts_policy: These suites overlap. Their counts are not summed into an independent overall test total.
